A '''steel shovel''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], made by smithing an [[Iron Shovel|iron shovel]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It mines at speed 8 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_shovel.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines shovel blocks at speed 8.

=== Combat ===

It deals 3.5 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack damage 4.5 (real value 3.5).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_shovel.json}}</ref>
